ffmpeg.exe in this folder is FFmpeg 8.1 (LGPL build) from https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
FFmpeg source code: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html  (build scripts: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds)
Its licence is in ffmpeg-LICENSE.txt. Spoilaint runs it as a separate program to read movie audio and subtitles.
